audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Shen levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items and called level 1 'Skill', while the page's own whys[0..4] argue Garen wins every one of those early stages.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror set the chart to Garen for rows 0-5 with Skill at 2+ items. Decisive Strike's silence on a flat 8s cooldown denies Shadow Dash, Courage's tenacity shortens the taunt, and Judgment passes through Spirit's Refuge because the block only stops attacks.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Skill in both layers as one atomic group, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whys array was off by one at the back end — whys[4] (the Level 6 row) described 'Pre-6', and whys[5] (the First item row) described Stand United coming online at 6.
audit.why: Rows 4 and 5 are labelled Level 6 and First item. Shen's level-6 spike is a map spike, not a lane one, so it does not flip the duel; the first-item row belongs to Garen because the Q silence still denies the pattern.
audit.corrected: whys[4] rewritten to the actual level-6 stage (Demacian Justice, 120s at rank 1, true damage) and whys[5] to the first-item stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase text was boilerplate that never named a single Garen ability interaction, though the content layer had them right.
audit.why: The three interactions that decide this lane are: Decisive Strike silences and cancels Shadow Dash (8s flat); Courage grants tenacity that cuts the taunt short (22s at rank 1); Judgment is not an attack, so Spirit's Refuge does not block it.
audit.corrected: All three written into the full-layer phase whys with their cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advised armour and an early Thornmail component, with nothing about the execute.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated: Demacian Justice deals true damage, so armour and MR do not reduce it. Staying above the execute threshold is a health-pool problem, not a resistance one.
audit.corrected: Itemization now says armour does not stop Demacian Justice and to buy raw HP to stay above the threshold.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Stand United' — false positive, Stand United is the correct Riot name for Shen's R.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences on a flat 8s cooldown — it cancels Shadow Dash mid-cast, so never open level 1 while his Q is up.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Courage gives shield and tenacity, cutting your taunt short — trade only once it is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Judgment spins through Spirit's Refuge — the block stops attacks, not his E, so he still out-damages your level-3 pattern.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Perseverance regenerates the chip back the moment you stop — either convert a trade into kill pressure or do not start it.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Demacian Justice is true damage on a 120s cooldown — armour will not save you. Stand United buys the map; it does not win you this duel.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet helps, but his 8s Q silence still denies the pattern — trade on Courage.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, neither of you kills the other cleanly — carry threat 7/10. Win it with Stand United, not the side lane.

edits.before: Pre-6 Garen can all-in effectively if he silences you first; without Stand United online you cannot threaten the map to offset his lane lead, so the lane remains his.
edits.after: Demacian Justice executes on 120s at rank 1 and deals true damage, so resistances do not save you; Stand United buys the map, not the 1v1 — the lane stays his.

edits.before: Stand United comes online and the game opens up — use R to swing a side-lane fight and erase his CS lead through global impact rather than fighting him directly; the lane goes to Skill.
edits.after: First item lands and Garen still holds the duel — his Q silence on a flat 8s denies the pattern you paid for, so cash the lead in with Stand United elsewhere rather than the 1v1.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (sticky taunt follow-up), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps. Armour will not stop Demacian Justice — buy raw HP and stay above the execute threshold.

notes: Packet levelChart and the mirror disagree on one row: the packet has 'Skill' at First item, the mirror set that row to Garen. I followed the mirror so the two directions cannot contradict. Also fixed a back-end off-by-one in whys[] (Level 6 and First item rows described the wrong stages) — the same defect the Galio audit reported, so it may be batch-wide across Shen's content file and worth a sweep.
